wordProblems.q: Grace has $30. Grace earns $29 helping a neighbour, then spends $31 on lunch. How many dollars does Grace have now?
A hall has 8 rows of chairs with 6 chairs in each row. The teacher adds 6 more chairs. How many chairs are there in all?
Ben collects 19 shells on Saturday and 34 shells on Sunday. Ben gives 10 shells to a friend. How many shells does Ben have left?
Liam has 16 buttons. Liam buys twice as many buttons as Liam already has, plus 16 more. How many buttons does Liam have now?
Ava, Emma and Mia each have 5 pencils. Their teacher gives them 13 more pencils to share. How many pencils do they have in all?
Ethan has 30 stickers. Ethan gives away 4 stickers, then buys 3 packs with the same number of stickers left in each pack. How many stickers does Ethan buy?
There are 57 red cars and 19 blue cars in a car park. 9 cars drive away. How many cars are left in the car park?
A ticket costs $4. Ava buys 3 tickets and a snack for $5. How many dollars does Ava spend in all?
Jack buys 3 packs of 7 pens and 3 packs of 7 pencils. How many pens and pencils does Jack buy in all?
81 children go on a school trip. 29 children ride in the first bus. The rest ride in the second bus. How many children ride in the second bus?
A baker makes 5 trays with 11 cookies on each tray. Her family eats 17 cookies. How many cookies are left?
James plants 7 rows of carrots with 9 carrots in each row. Then James plants 19 more carrots. How many carrots did James plant in all?
Liam saves $4 every week for 3 weeks. Then Liam spends $5 on a game. How many dollars does Liam have left?
A library has 6 shelves with 7 books on each shelf. The librarian adds 5 more books. How many books are there in all?
A shop has 3 boxes with 8 apples in each box. The shop sells 6 apples. How many apples are left?
Lucas has 46 red beads and 16 blue beads. Lucas uses 47 beads to make a necklace. How many beads does Lucas have left?
A cook has 3 cartons with 12 eggs in each carton. She uses 19 eggs to bake cakes. How many eggs are left?
Ruby scores 42 points in the first game and 28 points in the second game. Ruby gets 12 bonus points. How many points does Ruby have in all?
A farmer fills 8 baskets with 7 oranges in each basket. He gives 42 oranges to his neighbours. How many oranges are left?
Noah is reading a book with 90 pages. Noah reads 16 pages on Monday and 14 pages on Tuesday. How many pages are left to read?
Isabella saves $6 every week for 5 weeks. Then Isabella buys a kite for $12 and a puzzle for $15. How many dollars does Isabella have left?
A school has 5 classes with 6 children in each class. 5 new children join, and 18 children are away today. How many children are at school today?
Zoe has 17 ribbons. Her mum gives her twice as many ribbons as she already has, then Zoe gives 11 ribbons to a friend. How many ribbons does Zoe have now?
A shop has 5 crates with 6 bottles of juice in each crate. The shop sells 22 bottles. How many bottles are left?
Owen scores 14 points on Monday, 25 points on Tuesday and 14 points on Wednesday. How many points does Owen score in all?
Lily plants 7 rows of beans with 7 seeds in each row. 39 seeds grow into plants. How many seeds do not grow?
An adult ticket costs $7 and a child ticket costs $4. Leo buys 2 adult tickets and 2 child tickets. How many dollars does Leo spend in all?
Jack is reading a book with 85 pages. Jack reads 25 pages on Friday and 38 pages on Saturday. How many pages are left to read?
A market has 6 baskets with 8 apples in each basket and 2 baskets with 8 pears in each basket. The market sells 54 pieces of fruit. How many pieces of fruit are left?
A cook bakes 6 trays with 9 cupcakes on each tray. The children eat 39 cupcakes. How many cupcakes are left?
